--- gql_braced_ambiguity_value_ident.sql
-- Regression: VALUE used as an identifier must not be hijacked by VALUE { gql } lookahead.
value IN (1, 2)
--- AST
&ast.InExpr{
  Left: &ast.Ident{
    NamePos: 92,
    NameEnd: 97,
    Name:    "value",
  },
  Right: &ast.ValuesInCondition{
    Lparen: 101,
    Rparen: 106,
    Exprs:  []ast.Expr{
      &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 102,
        ValueEnd: 103,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "1",
      },
      &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 105,
        ValueEnd: 106,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "2",
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
value IN (1, 2)
